Why Paws Boutique

Most people buy a puppy from a photo and hope for the best. We'd rather you meet them. Every puppy here is vet-checked, vaccinated for its age and at least eight weeks old — and goes home with the records to prove it.

Our health promise

Every puppy goes home with the paperwork.

  • Vet health check

    Every puppy is examined by a vet before it goes home.

  • Vaccinated for age

    Vaccinations up to date for the puppy's age, with the record in hand.

  • Dewormed

    Deworming done on schedule, dates written down.

  • At least 8 weeks old

    No puppy leaves its mother before eight weeks.

  • Diet & care chart

    What to feed, how much, and when — for the first months.

  • WhatsApp support

    Questions after you take your puppy home? Message us.

45°C

Honest advice

Amritsar in June is 45 degrees.

Some breeds love it. Some need air-conditioning. We'll always tell you which is which before you choose.

Questions

Asked before
every puppy.

Why don't you show prices online?

Price depends on the breed, the parents, coat colour and whether the puppy is KCI-registered. Prices also change with each litter. Tell us what you are looking for and we will send you the exact price of the puppies available right now.

Can I see the puppy before I pay?

Yes. Visit us in Amritsar, or ask for a live video call and we will show you the puppy and its parents.

Do the puppies come with KCI papers?

KCI-registered puppies are available for many breeds. Ask when you request a price and we will tell you which puppies have papers.

Which breeds suit an Amritsar summer?

Short-coated breeds like the Labrador, Beagle, Doberman and Great Dane cope well. Short-nosed breeds (Pug, French and English Bulldog) and heavy-coated breeds (Husky, Samoyed, Saint Bernard) need an air-conditioned room from April to September. We will always tell you honestly.

Do you deliver outside Amritsar?

Tell us your city when you request a price and we will confirm delivery options and timing.

What support do I get after I take the puppy home?

You get a diet and care chart, the vaccination schedule, and our WhatsApp number for any question in the first months.
